results.evidence: The exhibit describes a planned platform Phase 2 trial in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis (N~500) testing SPY001/002/003 and combos, with clinical remission at W12 as primary. The bound NCT07148414 diverges on at least three axes: indication (RA/PsA/axSpA vs UC), enrollment magnitude (285 vs ~500), and primary endpoint family (DAS-CRP/ADAS/ACR20 vs clinical remission). The registry almost certainly describes a different trial than the claim.
